parsed.reason: Description A says partner-origin matching ignores port and userinfo (parts.hostname drops them), so origins with ports/userinfo are accepted and echoed. Description B says the endswith(domain) check lacks a dot-boundary, so unrelated hosts like bluekettle.example match kettle.example. These are different root causes (port/userinfo handling vs. suffix matching without label boundary), even though both sit in the same is_allowed branch.
